name.description: Optional name locally unique to the parent {@link FlowGraph}. Useful for user-facing APIs such as visualization.

inTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

outTypes.description:
key - port name
value - information about type associated with this port. This is useful for {@link FlowGraph.Edge} validation.

parents.description:
ids of parent vertices in {@Workflow#parent} {@link FlowGraph}. NOTE: there can be multiple in the case
that several vertices in the parent {@link FlowGraph} were merged as part of translation to a single vertex
in the new graph.

timeout.description:
Timeout for the execution of the vertex. After timeout time has passed the vertex execution fails if not
successfully completed or failed already.

handlerType.description:
Handler that contains functions for mapping the {@link #action}'s output to a {@link Workflow.Run} and for extracting
the "result" of the {@link #action} from the {@link Workflow.Run}.
If unspecified, then the output of the {@link #action} is assumed to be a {@link Workflow.Run}, and there will
be no result output for this vertex. Note that this matches the output behavior of {@link Workflow.Nested}.

title:
A specialized {@link Workflow.Vertex} that represents an {@link ActionRef}. Notably, this vertex differs from
{@link Workflow.Action} in that it specifically represents an asynchronous action, implemented with an underlying
(i.e. nested) {@link Workflow}. This vertex will take the action output, which is usually a reference to the
underlying {@link Workflow.Run}, wait on it, and extract the output to set as the result for the action.
This vertex differs from {@link Workflow.Nested} in that it specifies how to extract a result from the underlying
{@link Workflow.Run} output. Additionally, the underlying {@link Workflow} is dynamically generated (by the action)
and not statically defined.
Every {@link Workflow.Nested.Action} has multiple input ports: a port "$start" and a number of ports whose names
match the arguments to the configured {@link #action}.
Every {@link Workflow.Nested.Action} has three output ports: an optional port "out", a port "$success", and a port
"error".
The "out" output represents the result of the {@link Workflow.Run} that is spawned by the {@link #action}, if any.
See {@link Workflow} for more details on the ports "$start", "$success", and "error".

-------------------                            ----------------------------
| Workflow.Action | $success --------> $start  |                          | $success --------> ...
-------------------                            |                          |
                                               |  Workflow.Nested.Action  | error -----------> ...
-------------------                            |                          |                       -------------------
| Workflow.Input  | out -------------> arg1    |                          | out -------------> in | Workflow.Output |
-------------------                            ----------------------------                       -------------------
name: Workflow.Nested.Action
